items.label: Material
items.value: The long sleeve shirred cuff blouse made of 35% Cotton+65% Polyester. Skin- Friendly fabric which is lightweight, very soft and comfy to wear.

items.label: Feature
items.value: Turn-down collar, striped, long sleeves with smocked cuffs, bust pocket and front button closures, this oversize fit is sure to make the wearer feel slender.

items.label: Matching
items.value: The elastic cuff shirt top for women, good match with pants to complete the look, perfect to wear daily or as a beach cover-up matching with a bikini.

items.label: Fit Note
items.value: This shirt is designed with an oversized silhouette. For a closer fit, consider ordering one size down. Check the size chart for guidance, and don’t hesitate to reach out with any questions!

items.label: Wash Care
items.value: Machine Washable In Gentle, Recommend Hand Wash In Cold Water, Line Dry, Do Not Bleach.
